findings.seen: The athlete wears a loose-fitting slate blue-grey t-shirt with darker slate bands at the sleeve cuffs. It has a small crest on the left chest featuring a dark watchtower on an off-white shield with a gold border. There are no other markings or logos.

findings.seen: The athlete is wearing plain black ribbed crew socks that sit well above the shoe collar.

findings.seen: The athlete wears black low-cut skate shoes with white rubber foxing tape around the base and black laces. The shoes feature a prominent white curved side stripe on the black upper.
